program: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering

program_educational_objectives.description: Graduates shall have sound knowledge regarding the fundamental principles and techniques in the discipline of Computer Science and Engineering.
Graduates shall have the ability to specify, design, develop and maintain reliable and efficient software.
Graduates shall have the necessary communication and management skills and ethical values to become competent professionals.

programme_outcomes.title: Engineering Knowledge
programme_outcomes.description: Apply mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and CSE specialization to solve complex engineering problems.

programme_outcomes.title: Problem Analysis
programme_outcomes.description: Identify, formulate, research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems using mathematics and engineering sciences.

programme_outcomes.title: Design / Development of Solutions
programme_outcomes.description: Design solutions and develop software systems considering safety and societal factors.

programme_outcomes.title: Investigation of Complex Problems
programme_outcomes.description: Use research-based knowledge, experiments, data analysis, and synthesis to provide valid conclusions.

programme_outcomes.title: Modern Tool Usage
programme_outcomes.description: Create, select, and apply modern engineering and IT tools effectively.

programme_outcomes.title: Engineer and Society
programme_outcomes.description: Assess societal, health, safety, legal, and cultural issues relevant to engineering practice.

programme_outcomes.title: Environment and Sustainability
programme_outcomes.description: Understand environmental impact and sustainable development needs.

programme_outcomes.title: Ethics
programme_outcomes.description: Apply ethical principles and professional responsibilities.

programme_outcomes.title: Individual and Team Work
programme_outcomes.description: Function effectively as an individual and in multidisciplinary teams.

programme_outcomes.title: Communication
programme_outcomes.description: Communicate effectively through reports, presentations, and instructions.

programme_outcomes.title: Project Management and Finance
programme_outcomes.description: Apply engineering and management principles in multidisciplinary environments.

programme_outcomes.title: Life-long Learning
programme_outcomes.description: Engage in independent and lifelong learning with technological advancement.

programme_specific_outcomes.description: Analyze computational problems and design efficient algorithmic solutions.
Write effective code and use modern software tools for efficient systems.
Apply core CSE concepts to solve real-world multidisciplinary problems.

institute_core.title: Mathematics I
course_outcomes: CO1: Find limits, continuity and differentiability of functions of one variable.
CO2: Analyze functions of several variables using partial derivatives and optimization techniques.
CO3: Evaluate definite, improper, double and triple integrals and apply them to geometrical and physical problems.
CO4: Apply vector calculus concepts including line integrals, surface integrals and integral theorems.
topics: Functions of one variable, limits, continuity, differentiability, mean value theorems, Taylor theorem, maxima and minima
Integration, improper integrals, Beta and Gamma functions, curves in space, curvature and torsion
Functions of several variables, partial derivatives, directional derivatives, gradient, Hessian matrix, Lagrange multipliers
Double and triple integrals, Jacobians, polar/cylindrical/spherical coordinates, center of gravity and moments of inertia
Vector fields, divergence, curl, line integrals, Green’s theorem, Gauss divergence theorem and Stokes theorem
references: H. Anton, I. Bivens and S. Davis, Calculus, 10th Edition, Wiley, 2015
G. B. Thomas, M.D. Weir and J. Hass, Thomas’ Calculus, 12th Edition, Pearson, 2015
E. Kreyszig, Advanced Engineering Mathematics, 10th Edition, Wiley, 2015
T. M. Apostol, Calculus Vol. 1, Wiley, 2014
